parsed_json.up: Select: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id; assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid; activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno; molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1250402'; activities.standard_type = 'IC50'; activities.standard_relation = '='; activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC. Limit: 1000.
